projectName.label: Vercel project name
projectName.help: Vercel finds or creates a project with this name on every publish.

config.name: teamId
config.label: Team ID
config.help: Only for a team account. Leave blank for a personal account.

credential.help: An access token from your Vercel account.

fields.name: blobToken
fields.label: Blob read-write token
fields.help: Optional, only for site export share links. Vercel: Storage > your Blob store > .env.local, the BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN value. Leave blank to only publish.
fields.userHelp: Optional. Only needed to share site exports as a download link. In Vercel, open Storage, pick (or create) a Blob store and copy its BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN.
